$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside .ds-ai-composer. Figma's trailing frame stretches to the leading button (and, while dictating, wraps the waveform or status); ours hugs its buttons, so its width is not compared (the body, waveform and status widths are). Column: Figma's body frame holds the text frame; both are the field (body without its padding).
